en: Black‑and‑white view of a narrow, cobblestoned street lined with old plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and stepped or crow‑stepped gables. Ornate wall‑mounted streetlamps project from the building on the right. The street curves away between the historic townhouses; a small animal, likely a cat, crosses the roadway. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the front.
